name: SuperHub-v2
desc:
SuperHub-v2 is a calm, modern home screen for Supernote: a clock with this month's calendar, ten clean line-icon buttons you name and point at anything (folders, notes, apps, a new note, a new typed document, Favourites, Starred pages, Keywords, Search), and your recent pages at a glance.

Open it: in a note, tap the plugin button in the toolbar and choose SuperHub-v2. After that, tap the floating house on any screen. Set up your buttons with the gear at the top left.

Needs file access to show and open your files and save settings. No internet.

Based on SuperDashboard by AgP42 (MIT licence): https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard
